artefact.question: ACN 上季度的新签订单（bookings）是多少？

sections.body: 我不知道。账本里目前没有任何一条记录 Accenture 新签订单金额的 Claim，只有季度收入与同比增速。要回答这个问题需要先补上最近四个季度的 bookings 数字，来源是季报与电话会原文。在补上之前，任何数字都会是无来源的。

sections.title: 答案

shown_claims.statement: Accenture plc reported Revenues of USD 18718144000 for 2026-03-01..2026-05-31, up 5.59% year over year from USD 17727871000 in the comparable quarter.
Accenture plc reported Revenues of USD 18044066000 for 2025-12-01..2026-02-28, up 8.31% year over year from USD 16659301000 in the comparable quarter.

shown_claims.metric_or_aspect: Demand replacement and AI monetization risk
shown_claims.statement: Accenture states that if demand for existing services is not replaced by demand for new AI-enabled solutions and services, or if the pace and level of spending on new solutions is insufficient, its results of operations and utilization will be adversely affected.

Accenture identifies in-house IT departments of large corporations using global capability centers as a competitive threat because clients may use their own resources rather than engage an outside firm.

EPAM SYSTEMS, INC. reported Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax of USD 1353443000 for 2025-04-01..2025-06-30, up 18.04% year over year from USD 1146597000 in the comparable quarter.
EPAM reports utilization rates of its delivery professionals increased modestly year over year, with a slightly larger increase compared to the prior year, suggesting stable demand.

note: 正例，且是评分表里唯一一个「答不出来是满分」的案例：证据不足时直说不知道，并点名需要补什么。ADR-0006 的答案只能来自展示过的 Claim，这一条把它推到极端。
